explanation: Run a depth-first search using white, gray and black vertex colors. Reaching a gray vertex finds a back edge and hence a directed cycle; black vertices are already complete.
spaceComplexity: O(V) recursion; the supplied wrapper builds O(V+E) adjacency storage
